name: 背旧书箱的老人
src: 月银纪史诗/第十五歌_日冕之晨.md:504
who: A very old man sitting at the foot of the east city's wall with an old book chest on his back; he is the god of the elements walking among people, unrecognised until the dawn of the crowning. He looks about eighty-five: about 180 cm, thin, long-limbed and slightly stooped. Long crimson hair, red as no old man's hair should be, with ash settled on his eyebrows; sharp amber-gold eyes that watch and say nothing. Every fingertip stained with long-dried black ink. The leather of his book chest is rubbed shiny, one corner scorched, one rimed with a little frost, one marked with a white lightning-strike scar. Silent, watchful, ancient.
face: FACE, as in the references, but very old: a lean, deeply lined face of about eighty-five, a high forehead, long crimson hair and a short crimson beard, ash-grey dust on the eyebrows, sharp amber-gold eyes under heavy lids. Skin shadows a cool tone.
build: 180 cm, tall, thin and slightly stooped: long limbs, bony shoulders.
palette: crimson, ink black, faded ochre wool, worn chestnut leather, ash grey
casual: A wanderer's clothes: a long faded ochre wool robe, straight-cut, with long sleeves and a lacing at the throat, a rope belt with an ink horn and a reed pen tucked in it, a worn grey travelling cloak pinned at one shoulder, old sandals over wool foot-wraps. On his back the old leather-covered book chest on two straps, its corners scorched, frosted and lightning-marked. He stands holding the chest's strap with an ink-stained hand, silent, watching.
private: Resting by the wall: the book chest set down at his feet, the cloak around his shoulders over the long ochre robe; he hugs the closed old book to his chest with both ink-stained hands. A wary, private look.
battle: At dawn when he opens the book: the ochre robe and grey cloak, the book chest open on its straps at his side, a heavy old book open across his left forearm and a reed pen in his right hand; he carries no weapon. A faint five-coloured light, flame red, frost blue, storm violet, leaf green and gold, plays along the pen tip and the edges of the open page, and the scorched, frosted and lightning-marked corners of the chest glow faintly.
battle_pose: 3) the writing outfit: standing, the open book on the left forearm, the reed pen lifted in the right hand about to write, the eyes intent; he never fights and holds no weapon.
formal: After the crowning dawn, recognised: the same faded ochre robe under a new crimson wool mantle pinned with a plain gold clasp, the hair combed back, the book chest on his back, the closed book held upright against his chest with both hands. Standing straight for once, a stern, quiet look.
art: A portrait at dawn: he sits against an old stone city wall with the book open on his knees and looks up at the viewer, sharp amber-gold eyes under ash-dusted brows, the pen poised. Warm golden sunrise from one side, cool grey dawn shadow on the other. Foreground blur: drifting dust motes and the scorched corner of the book chest.
gear: 神（人间扮相，不出手）｜——｜不打仗｜不分档｜祂在人间不动手，只落笔，第三格画天亮翻书那一下，笔尖和书页边上的五色微光是兆头。
